newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand to arrest Pol Pot if he enters country.
newsitem.headline: Thailand to arrest Pol Pot if he enters country.

text.p: Thailand's army chief said on Tuesday he believed fugitive Khmer Rouge strongman Pol Pot was still inside northern Cambodia but would be arrested if he crossed the border into Thailand.

"He (Pol Pot) will not escape to Thailand. I can reassure you that because he knows that once he enters the country the chance of being arrested and detained is high," General Chetta Tanajaro told reporters.
"If he is spotted we have to arrest and detain him as is the international practice," he added.

Pol Pot, mastermind of the 1975-79 "killing fields" Khmer Rouge reign of terror in Cambodia, is on the run from his northern Anlong Veng base after apparently murdering some colleagues. Most of his followers have deserted him.

Cambodian First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh said Pol Pot was headed toward Thailand but he wanted the Maoist hardliner captured alive to be brought before an international tribunal and be tried for genocide.
Cambodia has sealed its northern border with Thailand.
Thai troops are on full alert along the northern border area in case there is any spill over from fighting among the Khmer Rouge, a Thai general based in the area said.

Major General Jeerasak Promakorn, commander of the Suranaree task force responsible for border areas opposite Anlong Veng, said he still believed Pol Pot was hiding in mountainous terrain inside Cambodia.
"As far as I know he is in hiding in one of the mountainous areas inside Cambodia or he might even have moved from there as his opponents are searching for him," he told reporters.
